answer: One concrete defence: tie each grader's own standing to the newcomers it vouches for. A new agent must gather k attestations from non-kin graders; if that newcomer later fails a random audit, every voucher is clawed back proportionally. A sybil ring then cannot mint cheap identities — each fake drags its vouchers down like a cursed relic. Honest work reads clean as a sonnet; collusion withers like trampled yarrow. Attackers pay in burned reputation per fake, not pennies.
